recalled_knowledge.item: Total atmospheric neutrino flux above ~10 MeV, all flavours, ~10.5 cm^-2 s^-1 (used only as a sanity check; normalisation fixed to LZ's 0.11 events)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Billard, Strigari, Figueroa-Feliciano PRD 89, 023524 (2014) Table I

recalled_knowledge.item: Atmospheric flux shape: E dPhi/dE roughly flat 10-100 MeV, falling ~E^-2..-3 above; Honda-type E^2 dPhi/dE rising to ~1 GeV then steepening to E^-2.7
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Battistoni et al. 2005 (FLUKA), Honda et al. 2011/2015

recalled_knowledge.item: sin^2 theta_W = 0.23867 at low momentum transfer
CEvNS cross-section dsigma/dE_R = G_F^2 m_N/(4 pi) Q_W^2 (1 - m_N E_R/2E^2) F^2, Q_W = N - (1-4 s2w) Z
Llewellyn-Smith NC elastic cross-section with A, B, C structure and NC form factors F1,2^NC = +-1/2(F^p - F^n) - 2 s2w F^{p,n}, F_A^NC = +-g_A/2 G_D; dipole M_A = 1.03 GeV, M_V = 0.84 GeV
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Llewellyn Smith 1972; Ahrens et al. 1987; MiniBooNE NCE 2010

recalled_knowledge.item: Fermi-gas Pauli suppression factor 1.5x - 0.5x^3 (x = q/2k_F) and k_F ~ 260 MeV/c for a heavy nucleus
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Bodek-Ritchie / relativistic Fermi gas; Moniz et al. 1971 (k_F(Pb) = 265 MeV/c)

recalled_knowledge.item: Neutron total cross-section on Xe at ~30 MeV ~ 2.7 b -> lambda ~ 27 cm in LXe
Ground-state spectroscopic fraction for valence-neutron removal 0.1-0.5; excited daughters emit >= 0.5 MeV gammas
129Xe first excited state 39.58 keV (3/2+), 131Xe 80.19 keV (1/2+); decays dominantly by conversion electrons/gammas
Allowed NC inelastic cross-section sigma ~ (G_F^2 E^2/pi)(g_A^2/4) B(sigma), B(sigma) ~ 0.05-0.2 for low-lying M1 transitions
Vogel-Engel coherent magnetic-moment formula dsigma/dE_R = pi alpha^2 mu^2/m_e^2 Z^2 F^2 (1/E_R - 1/E_nu + E_R/4E_nu^2)
Scalar-mediator CEvNS spectrum dsigma/dE_R ~ Q_s^2 m_N^2 E_R/(E_nu^2 (q^2+m^2)^2); vector mediator modifies Q_W by g^2 Q'/(sqrt2 G_F (q^2+m^2))
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Cerdeno, Fairbairn, Jubb, Machado, Vincent, Boehm JHEP 2016

recalled_knowledge.item: Dipole-portal Lagrangian d nu_L sigma^{mu nu} N_4 F_{mu nu} and coherent up-scattering phenomenology (cross-section derived here by trace algebra, checked against the m4->0 limit)
Solar hep end point 18.8 MeV; 8B end point ~16.3 MeV
2->2 kinematics in the CM frame (t range, threshold)
Xe isotopic abundances and Helm parametrisation (via lzcommon)

First bottom-panel tick calibration (193 px/decade) ignored that labels are every two decades; fixed (96.5 px/decade) and validated against the caption total (0.01082 vs 0.0106).
Step-function kinematic kernel for the dipole-portal spectrum caused quad round-off warnings; replaced by bisection for E_nu,min(E_R, m4) and integration over the allowed range only.
